algorithm.method: exact: optional candidates split into coverage-independent components; each component solved by a signature dynamic program (covered-once / covered-twice masks, one cheapest plan per signature, key-bit tie-break), then components combined by an exact knapsack over total purchase cost
algorithm.worst_case_complexity: sum over components of O(m_c * S_c), S_c <= min(2^m_c, 3^s_c) distinct coverage signatures (m_c candidates, s_c served samples in component c); the combine is O(n_cost_levels^2). Equivalent to enumerating 2^n_optional subsets, but merges identical coverage signatures and splits on independent components
